standard_position: Need-to-know disclosure to employees, affiliates, agents, advisors, contractors with equivalent NDA
fallback_positions: Employees and affiliates with prior notice
Employees and affiliates with prior consent
red_line: Limits disclosure exclusively to named individuals or requires consent for sharing with affiliated entities
escalation_logic: Does not permit sharing with affiliates or advisors under any circumstances
rationale: Enables operational use of info with affiliates, advisors, contractors
